thread.document:
This is so students can ask questions about the lecture. I forgot to mention in lecture that Chapters 14 and 17 in Prince are relevant.

Remember, after starting Generative models, we are going to do a little interlude to go through more details of test-time compute and post-training for LLMs. The reason we're doing this is two-fold: 

A) The VAE discussion, along with the homework, has unlocked some of the technical tools that we are going to need. Since we have enough now, we can return to post-training since it continues our earlier theme of fine-tuning.

B) Some of the things that we are going to be hitting during post-training will then help us in understanding diffusion-based generative models --- which is what we will do afterwards.
